masters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one 16:9 landscape master background for the Cosmic Dungeon in-game help guide, requested size 1536x864. Theme: village. Depict the restored village's modest timber supply stalls remembered by rescued souls, small warm lantern-lit counter and distant pale oak timber at night, a refuge with a faint haunted atmosphere. No people. Dark charcoal, muted moss, desaturated warm brown and tiny soft amber accents. Dark painterly broad pixel-friendly shapes, restrained brush texture, soft atmospheric edges, consistent handcrafted fantasy game background. Composition is essential: left 65% and central lower area almost empty very dark low-contrast shadow for dense light help text; only a compact recognizable motif of a timber stall and lantern centered around normalized x .72 y .35, no important objects in the outer 13% margins. Subject should survive center crops to 4:3 and 21:9. Keep the motif subtle, not a bright hero image; full artwork without any frame. No text, letters, signs, logos, watermark, UI, emblems, coins, portals, bosses, large creatures or promises of further unavailable content.

inspection.notes: Modest timber supply stall and muted lantern in village refuge; quiet dark left field. No identifiable NPC, unavailable buildings or gameplay promise. Background architectural details are atmospheric, not a world-layout map.
